name: Sour seafood hotpot
summary: Lẩu in Hạ Long is a sour pot. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, says the usual seafood is squid, shrimp, cá song, local clam or ngao tây, hà, and crab, and the souring is me, chay, tai chua, or tomato.
origin: Hạ Long. Báo Quảng Ninh, 9 Jul 2015, as the meal when the table chooses a hotpot instead of the grilled plates.
howToEat: The broth is soured with one of me, chay, tai chua, or cà chua. The usual seafood is mực, tôm, cá song, ngao ta or ngao tây, hà, and ghẹ or cua. Greens are whatever the table wants. The account’s usual bunch is rau muống, cải soong, cải xanh, fresh bulb onion, rau cần, súp lơ, and mushroom, plus plain tofu eaten very hot.
The account says the pot ends with bánh đa or mì tôm. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
where: The hotpot version of the ordinary seafood meal. Not a named stall.
seoTitle: Lau hai san Ha Long — sour seafood hotpot
seoDescription: The Hạ Long hotpot is soured with me, chay, tai chua, or tomato, and loaded with squid, shrimp, cá song, clam, and crab. A price was not printed. Check on arrival.
